_comment: Illustrative trust-policy fragments. This file is documentation data, not a standalone IAM policy and is not consumed by Terraform.
_mfa_note: Enforce human MFA in IAM Identity Center or the upstream IdP. AWS documents that aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent is absent for federated identities; these trust policies therefore do not test that key.
_boundary_note: The Terraform attaches the permission boundary to WorkloadSecurityReadRole only. It does not automatically attach it to every role in the account.

assumption_flow.step_1: Operator authenticates to IAM Identity Center; MFA must be enforced by the identity provider or Identity Center policy.
assumption_flow.step_2: Operator's exact Management-account permission-set role assumes SecurityAssumeWorkloadReadRole in the Security account.
assumption_flow.step_3: SecurityAssumeWorkloadReadRole assumes WorkloadSecurityReadRole in the single configured workload account.
assumption_flow.step_4: WorkloadSecurityReadRole has a read-only policy and the WorkloadPermissionBoundary attached.
assumption_flow.step_5: Both Terraform-managed role sessions have a maximum duration of one hour.
